note: No .env is committed. The OpenAI key is server-side only (LangGraph agent). All AI tools are front-end CopilotKit actions that only add, update or remove dashboard widgets, so there are no AI write, send or booking tools. The prompt's read-only limits match the tool set. Drop All Patient Data has a confirm modal. The system prompt asks the model to give patients health interpretations with no output check. Test files, AGENTS.md and README were not reviewed.

labels.what: /api/copilotkit has no login or Medplum token check. Anyone can POST to it and drive the OpenAI-backed LangGraph agent. The agent server it proxies to (langgraph-cli dev on port 8123) also has no auth
No rate limit, quota or message size cap on the paid model endpoint. Each request sends the full readable app state plus history to OpenAI

Client-supplied CopilotKit context (readables) is pasted into the system message as 'Application State' with no validation. Any caller can inject instructions, and patient-writable record text (care plan notes, observation notes) flows into the system prompt

Medications, care plans, vitals, labs and any FHIR search results are sent as readables to the agent and on to OpenAI (and LangSmith when its key is set). No field minimization or data-processing check for PHI
MedplumClient is created with its default storage, which keeps the patient access token in browser localStorage, readable by any script on the page

Login check for Dashboard, Care Plans and Medications is only a client-side useEffect redirect. Children render before it runs. Medplum's access policy still protects the data, so impact is limited to the UI and the open /api/copilotkit route

Patient access policy gives full create, update and delete on their own Observation, DiagnosticReport, MedicationRequest, Coverage, PaymentNotice, CarePlan, Condition, AllergyIntolerance and Communication. A patient can forge prescriptions or diagnoses or delete clinician-entered records. Load Sample Data and Drop All Patient Data depend on this
Binary has no compartment criteria and no readonly flag, so every patient can read and write every Binary in the project (including bot code and attachments of other patients)

Load Sample Data writes generated Observations plus fixture MedicationRequests, CarePlans, DiagnosticReports and Conditions straight into the signed-in patient's real record. Nothing tags them as sample data and repeat clicks duplicate them. The AI then reads them as the patient's real history
Made-up 12-month health journey: weight 130 to 95 kg, BP 145/95 to 125/80, heart rate, glucose, HbA1c, cholesterol, eGFR, insulin and random temperature values
Fixture condition notes contradict the generated data: notes say 120 kg to 85 kg and HbA1c 8.2% to 5.4%, the generator uses 130 kg to 95 kg and HbA1c 6.2% to 5.4%
Fixture care plans name a fictional clinician 'Dr. Sarah Chen' as author and team member, plus fictional goals and progress notes, loaded as if real
Diagnostic reports reference Observation/PLACEHOLDER_GLUCOSE_DEC2023 and 9 similar ids. loadSampleData replaces only Patient/PLACEHOLDER and date tokens, so these result links are dangling
render_fhir_data_table tells the model count has max 100, but the add handler passes count through unclamped (only update_fhir_search clamps to 1..100 at line 495)
LangGraph deployment URL falls back to http://localhost:8123 when the env var is unset, so a missed setting in production points at localhost

Clinical thresholds hardcoded in UI code: eGFR 45 and 30 decide 'Metformin Safe', 'Caution' or 'Contraindicated' badges shown to patients. Lab normal ranges are hardcoded in constants/loincConstants.ts lines 45-91
Drop All Patient Data fetches at most 1000 resources per type with no paging, while the modal counts and promises all of them
